CarryToShrine01.name_zh: 死亡破火山口的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine01.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine01.start_en: Interact with Momosik Shrine on the eastern flank of Death Mountain in Eldin to trigger the green guidance beam.
CarryToShrine01.note_en: Follow the green light beam into Death Mountain East Tunnel partway up the mountain. Ride a minecart forward, clear the cracked red boulder, and defeat the Igneo Talus inside the volcanic cavern using ice fruit or ice arrows. Attach the crystal to a minecart or carry it back along the tracks to Momosik Shrine. (Extreme heat requires Flamebreaker armor; fast traveling drops the crystal).
CarryToShrine01.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到摩摩希卡神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine01.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Momosik Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine02.name_zh: 沉睡于吉萨的环形山的水晶
CarryToShrine02.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine02.start_en: Interact with Ikatak Shrine located inside the Gisa Crater in the Tabantha Frontier.
CarryToShrine02.note_en: Follow the green light into Gisa Crater Cave. Eliminate the Frost Like and monsters inside. Attach two Zonai Rockets to the crystal or place it on a floating platform and launch it out through the open hole in the cave ceiling. Climb or use Ascend to exit the cave, and deliver the crystal to Ikatak Shrine.
CarryToShrine02.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到伊卡塔克神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine02.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Ikatak Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine03.name_zh: 沉睡于幽芬湖的洞窟中的水晶
CarryToShrine03.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine03.start_en: Interact with Moshapin Shrine located inside Lake Intenoch Cave in Eldin Canyon.
CarryToShrine03.note_en: Follow the green light through the cave to a high ledge across a large lava pool. Wear Flamebreaker armor to endure the extreme heat. Use a Zonai Hydrant on the lava to solidify stone platforms, attach a Fan and Steering Stick to construct a motorized lava raft, and sail across to fetch the crystal and bring it back to Moshapin Shrine.
CarryToShrine03.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到摩夏皮恩神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine03.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Mosapin Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine05.name_zh: 哈特尔天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine05.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine05.start_en: Interact with Kumamayn Shrine on the Necluda Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine05.note_en: Follow the green light beam to the neighboring circular sky arena island. Defeat the Flux Construct III boss (or pull the crystal off its body using Ultrahand). Attach the crystal to a spring launcher device or assemble a fan-propelled Wing to transport it across the sky gap back to Kumamayn Shrine.
CarryToShrine05.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到克马马伊诺神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine05.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Kumamayn Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine06.name_zh: 海利亚湖的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine06.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine06.start_en: Interact with En-oma Shrine located deep inside Lake Hylia Whirlpool Cave.
CarryToShrine06.note_en: Launch from Popla Foothills Skyview Tower and glide south to the high sky island directly above Lake Hylia. Pick up the glowing green crystal and drop it straight down through the open hole in the island so it falls into the giant lake whirlpool below. Dive into the whirlpool behind it to enter the underwater cave and deliver the crystal to En-oma Shrine.
CarryToShrine06.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到艾恩欧马神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine06.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the En-oma Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine07.name_zh: 格鲁德峡谷的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine07.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine07.start_en: Interact with Rakakudaj Shrine situated at the bottom of the canyon in Gerudo Canyon.
CarryToShrine07.note_en: Follow the green guidance beam down the canyon riverbed to find the crystal resting by an enemy campfire. Assemble a multi-wheeled vehicle using nearby Zonai Wheels, a wooden chassis, and a Steering Stick. Attach the crystal and drive uphill against the canyon slopes and rocks back to Rakakudaj Shrine.
CarryToShrine07.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到拉卡克达吉托神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine07.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Rakashog Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine08_Zora.name_zh: 沉睡于拉尔斯水脉的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine08_Zora.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine08_Zora.start_en: Interact with Joniu Shrine inside the flooded Ralis Channel cave in the Lanayru Great Spring.
CarryToShrine08_Zora.note_en: Follow the green beam into Ralis Channel cave to locate the crystal on a wooden dock. Construct a motorized boat using the provided wooden boards, Fans, and Steering Stick. Place the crystal on the boat and steer upstream through the water tunnels, navigating around rocks and waterfalls to reach Joniu Shrine.
CarryToShrine08_Zora.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到乔尼乌神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine08_Zora.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Joniu Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine09.name_zh: 萨托利山的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine09.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine09.start_en: Interact with Usazum Shrine at the southwestern base of Satori Mountain in Hyrule Ridge.
CarryToShrine09.note_en: Follow the green light beam into Satori Mountain Foothill Cave. Defeat the sleeping Hinox inside (shoot its eye with arrows to stun it and deal melee damage). Pick up the shrine crystal dropped from its necklace and carry it out of the cave back to Usazum Shrine.
CarryToShrine09.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到乌萨诸马神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine09.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Usazum Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine10.name_zh: 拉聂尔参道的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine10.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine10.start_en: Interact with O-ogim Shrine located along Lanayru Road - East Gate.
CarryToShrine10.note_en: Follow the beam to the ancient ruins across the river canyon. Blast open the cracked rock wall to find the crystal alongside a Zonai Wing and Fans. Assemble an airplane with Fans and a Steering Stick, attach the crystal, place the plane on the runway tracks, and pilot it across the chasm directly back to O-ogim Shrine.
CarryToShrine10.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到欧欧基恩神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine10.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Gikaku Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine11.name_zh: 南海拉鲁天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine11.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine11.start_en: Interact with Jinodok Shrine on the South Hyrule Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine11.note_en: Operate the wheel crank mechanism on the central sky island to rotate the connecting catwalk bridge until it lines up with the adjacent floating island holding the crystal. Walk across, pick up the crystal with Ultrahand, and carry it across the bridge back to Jinodok Shrine.
CarryToShrine11.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到吉诺多卡欧神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine11.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Gutanbac Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine12.name_zh: 北哈特尔天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine12.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine12.start_en: Interact with Josiu Shrine on the North Necluda Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine12.note_en: Operate the crank wheel mechanism on the island to rotate the curved stone sky bridge until it aligns with the distant island holding the crystal. Walk across the curved bridge, retrieve the crystal, and bring it back to Josiu Shrine.
CarryToShrine12.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到乔希乌神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine12.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Jonsau Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine13.name_zh: 沉睡于拉纳湖的洞窟中的水晶
CarryToShrine13.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine13.start_en: Interact with Tokiy Shrine located inside Oakle's Navel Cave in East Necluda.
CarryToShrine13.note_en: Follow the green guidance beam deep into the narrow uphill tunnel of Oakle's Navel Cave. Dodge or use Recall on giant stone spheres rolling down the slope. Retrieve the crystal from the top chamber and carefully carry it back down the tunnel to Tokiy Shrine.
CarryToShrine13.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到拖奇悠乌神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine13.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Tokyou Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine14.name_zh: 采石之岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine14.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine14.start_en: Interact with Gikaku Shrine on The Sky Mine in Akkala Sky.
CarryToShrine14.note_en: Activate the Zonai terminal on the base island to power the catapult launchers. Use the rotating launcher to catapult Link and blocks upward through the tiered floating islands to reach the hollow upper sphere. Open the floor grate or lower the barrier to retrieve the crystal, then launch the crystal back down to Gikaku Shrine.
CarryToShrine14.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到奇卡肯神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine14.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Chichim Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine15.name_zh: 海布拉山北方的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine15.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine15.start_en: Interact with Sisuran Shrine on the snowy northern plateau of the Hebra Mountains.
CarryToShrine15.note_en: Follow the green light beam into the snowy basin and defeat the Frost Talus boss. Melt its icy exterior with Fire Fruit or fire arrows to climb onto its body and strike its ore deposit. Once defeated, collect the shrine crystal it drops and carry it back to Sisuran Shrine.
CarryToShrine15.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到希斯拉纳神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine15.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Sifumim Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine16.name_zh: 沉睡于海布拉山西北的洞窟中的水晶
CarryToShrine16.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine16.start_en: Interact with Rutafu-um Shrine inside Hebra Mountains Northwest Cave.
CarryToShrine16.note_en: Follow the green beam to the deep freezing subterranean pool where the crystal lies submerged. Throw Fire Fruit or use a torch to melt the surface ice sheet. Fuse an Icicle or Wing to create an extended reach or build a raft to lift the crystal from the freezing water, then carry it back up the slope to Rutafu-um Shrine.
CarryToShrine16.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到鲁塔富乌每神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine16.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Rutafu-um Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine17.name_zh: 南阿卡莱天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine17.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine17.start_en: Interact with Natak Shrine on the Sokkala Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine17.note_en: Use the rotating catapult launcher to fling Link inside the giant hollow metallic sphere. Inside the sphere, operate the central rotating wheel to align the spherical opening with the exterior spring launcher. Place the crystal into the launcher and trigger it to fire the crystal back to the main island, then return to Natak Shrine.
CarryToShrine17.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到纳塔卡卡神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine17.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Natak Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine19.name_zh: 北海拉鲁天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine19.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine19.start_en: Interact with Mayam Shrine on the North Hyrule Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine19.note_en: Follow the green beam across to the adjacent floating sky arena and defeat the Flux Construct I boss (or detach the crystal using Ultrahand). Attach the crystal to a Zonai Hover Stone or Wing equipped with Rockets/Fans, pilot it back across the open sky gap to the shrine island, and offer it to Mayam Shrine.
CarryToShrine19.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到马亚米伊神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine19.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Mayam Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine20.name_zh: 塔邦挞天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine20.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine20.start_en: Interact with Ganos Shrine on the Tabantha Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine20.note_en: Follow the green beam down to the lower floating arena island and defeat the Flux Construct III boss. Attach the recovered crystal to a flying Wing equipped with Fans, Batteries, and a Steering Stick, and fly upward back to the upper island to offer it to Ganos Shrine.
CarryToShrine20.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到加诺萨神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine20.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Ganos Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine21.name_zh: 东海布拉天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine21.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine21.start_en: Interact with Taninoud Shrine on the East Hebra Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine21.note_en: Adjust the rotating catapult launcher toward the higher neighboring sky island and launch Link across. Burn away the thick vines with Fire Fruit or a torch to reveal a hidden alcove containing the crystal. Assemble a flying machine using nearby Hover Platforms, Fans, and a Steering Stick to ferry the crystal back to Taninoud Shrine.
CarryToShrine21.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到塔尼诺乌达神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine21.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Taninoud Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine22.name_zh: 西哈特尔天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine22.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine22.start_en: Interact with Ukoojisi Shrine on the West Necluda Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine22.note_en: Follow the green beam to the island holding the crystal (or use the launcher to reach it). Assemble a Zonai Wing craft fitted with Fans, Batteries, and a Steering Stick. Attach the crystal securely to the nose of the Wing, take off from the runway, and fly across the sky chasm back to Ukoojisi Shrine.
CarryToShrine22.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到乌可欧吉希神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine22.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Ukoojisi Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CarryToShrine23.name_zh: 南拉聂尔天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
CarryToShrine23.start_zh: 献上水晶后，似乎就能进入破魔神庙。跟随光线指示的方向，将水晶献给神庙吧。
CarryToShrine23.start_en: Interact with Sihajog Shrine atop Mount Lanayru Sky / Valor Island in the South Lanayru Sky Archipelago.
CarryToShrine23.note_en: Speak to the Steward Construct on Valor Island to undertake the Dive Ceremony trial. Skydive from the pinnacle of the island downward through all glowing green rings within the time limit. Upon successfully completing the dive course, the crystal is presented and Sihajog Shrine materializes on the lower island.
CarryToShrine23.deliver_zh: 把水晶搬到马亚纳希神庙底座凹槽处放下（神庙随之升起、可进入）。
CarryToShrine23.deliver_en: Offer the crystal to the Mayanas Shrine pedestal socket to raise and activate the shrine.

CraftShadowPicture.start_zh: 坠落在拉聂尔山西北阔塔台地的遗迹内有一座圣之神庙，管家魔像传达了指引发现神庙的话语：
CraftShadowPicture.start_en: Speak to the Steward Construct at Quatta's Shelf ruins northwest of Mount Lanayru.
CraftShadowPicture.note_en: Insert the two wooden boards into the rotating cross-shaped mechanism using Ultrahand to replicate the geometric silhouette shown on the wall. Rotate the mechanism so that when the sun rises in the morning (around 06:00 AM), the shadow cast completely covers the white stone pattern on the cliff wall. Light a campfire to pass the time until morning to trigger Kurakat Shrine.
CraftShadowPicture.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

DevoteSpring.start_zh: 在比托谷的洞窟的深处发现了一处泉水。泉水边上有着不知何人写下的笔记，上面记载着有关左纳乌文明的传说。
DevoteSpring.start_en: Examine the Old Notebook resting beside the spring inside Tobio's Hollow Cave in Faron.
DevoteSpring.note_en: Pick up the Zonai Spear beside the journal and fuse a Keese Wing (or Aerocuda Wing) to its tip. Stand on the glowing green pedestal by the spring and throw the spear across the chasm through the center of the distant glowing green ring. Ringing the target opens the secret chamber revealing Utojis Shrine.
DevoteSpring.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

GiantHorse.start_zh: 遇见了一位名叫巴特克的爱马男子，他在费罗尼草原西南的山上捡到了一块漂亮的水晶。巴特克表示，这附近有人目击到了传闻中
GiantHorse.start_en: Speak to Baddek on the hill southwest of Faron Grasslands (near Ibara Butte).
GiantHorse.note_en: Travel to the Lake of the Horse God southeast of Highland Stable to find the Giant White Stallion roaming near the canyon. Tame the giant horse (requires high stamina or stamina-recovering food), ride it back to Baddek, and talk to him while mounted. Baddek will gladly hand over the green crystal in exchange for seeing the legendary steed. Carry the crystal down the slope to Ishokin Shrine.
GiantHorse.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

IceMaking.start_zh: 坠落在双子山山脚的遗迹内有一座圣之神庙，管家魔像传达了指引通往神庙的话语：
IceMaking.start_en: Speak to the Steward Construct at the ruins near the base of Dueling Peaks.
IceMaking.note_en: Create three ice slabs by throwing White Chuchu Jelly or Ice Fruit into the river water. Hold each ice slab near the campfire to melt it down to size until it fits into the three altar slots: top diamond slot (small), middle diamond slot (medium, angled), and bottom diamond slot (large). Once all three ice keys are slotted into place, Jochisiu Shrine will rise from the ground.
IceMaking.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

IchikaraChallenge03.start_zh: 哈吉企图以100卢比的价格强行卖出怪石头，被妻子哈鲁丽教训后，降价到50卢比。
IchikaraChallenge03.start_en: Speak to Hagie near the railcar station in Tarrey Town in Akkala.
IchikaraChallenge03.note_en: Hagie initially demands 100 Rupees for the glowing green crystal. Speak with his wife Rhondson/Hunnie to have her scold him, bringing the price down to 50 Rupees. Purchase the rock, attach it to the railcar to transport it down to the Hudson Construction Site, then load it onto a motorized boat or hovercraft across Lake Akkala to deliver it to Jochi-ihiga Shrine.
IchikaraChallenge03.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

InfiltrationFromTheSky.start_zh: 玛卡玛喀透露了自己的一个珍藏地点，但他说一片迷途之雾笼罩着那里，只有克洛格才能走过去。那地方似乎有绿色的圈圈，还能看见空中的岛屿。“
InfiltrationFromTheSky.start_en: Speak to Maca in the southwestern corner of the Korok Forest central clearing after cleansing the Great Deku Tree.
InfiltrationFromTheSky.note_en: Maca mentions a hidden shrine enveloped by the Lost Woods mist directly below a sky island. Launch from Typhlo Ruins Skyview Tower or glide from the sky islands above Korok Forest. Position Link directly above the designated target coordinates and skydive straight down through the cloud break to bypass the mist barrier and land directly beside Ninjis Shrine.
InfiltrationFromTheSky.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

Korok_CarryToShrine.name_en: A Pretty Stone and Five Golden Apples
Korok_CarryToShrine.start_zh: 将5个金苹果交给了达秘达米。达秘达米拿到了许多喜欢的金苹果因此看起来心满意足。按照约定，达秘达米将
Korok_CarryToShrine.start_en: Speak to Damidon on the eastern path of Korok Forest after cleansing the Great Deku Tree.
Korok_CarryToShrine.note_en: Damidon has the green crystal and requests five Golden Apples in exchange. Travel to Mido Swamp northeast of the forest or near Sonapan Shrine to harvest Golden Apples from the trees (use Ultrahand or arrows to pluck them from dangerous bottomless mud). Deliver five Golden Apples to Damidon to receive the crystal, then follow the light beam to Pupunke Shrine.
Korok_CarryToShrine.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

NoTrespassing.start_zh: 据阿兹基所说，曾经去过的森林深处有座像神庙一样的东西，但是现在出现了许多怪物，因此他正在看守，阻拦克洛格们进入。如果不是克洛格的话，他似乎可以放行。
NoTrespassing.start_en: Speak to Azuki at the northwestern exit of Korok Forest after cleansing the Great Deku Tree.
NoTrespassing.note_en: Azuki blocks Koroks from entering due to dangerous monsters ahead, but allows Link through. Follow the trail of Blue Nightshade flowers through the forest to a clearing with a Stone Talus. Defeat the Stone Talus to claim the shrine crystal stuck to its back, and carry the crystal forward to Sakunbomar Shrine.
NoTrespassing.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

Rito_ShadowCave.start_zh: 利特村的居民索里莱丝正在为想不起之前发现的洞窟位置而烦恼。据说那座洞窟里有
Rito_ShadowCave.start_en: Speak to Solles on the top perch of Rito Village after completing Tulin of Rito Village.
Rito_ShadowCave.note_en: Solles recalls spotting a cave shaped like a white bird in the morning shadow. Climb to the highest spire of Rito Village, wait until morning (around 06:00-07:00 AM) by a campfire, and look northwest toward the snow peak. The morning shadow of the village tower points directly to a snow patch resembling a white bird. Glide to the bird's belly on the mountain cliff to find West Lake Totori Cave and enter Wao-os Shrine.
Rito_ShadowCave.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.

SnowyMountain_Surfing.name_zh: 高天之泉与光环的传说
SnowyMountain_Surfing.name_en: The High Spring and the Light Rings
SnowyMountain_Surfing.start_zh: 在拉聂尔山山顶附近的智慧之泉边，纳兹比把流传于此地的传说告诉了你。
SnowyMountain_Surfing.start_en: Speak to Nazbi warming himself by the campfire near the Spring of Wisdom atop Mount Lanayru (or directly activate the sky terminal).
SnowyMountain_Surfing.note_en: Launch from Mount Lanayru Skyview Tower and glide to the high sky island above the peak. Interact with the glowing dragon ring terminal to initiate the shield surfing trial. Shield surf down the mountain slopes (jump and press ZL + A), passing through every green glowing ring along the snow run before the countdown timer expires. Passing the final ring summons Zakusu Shrine.
SnowyMountain_Surfing.deliver_en: The shrine reveals itself and becomes accessible.
